scope: Source mapping decisions only. Independent review of the inherited 49-file production port remains OPEN. No runtime execution, oracle parity, full-suite or milestone acceptance is established.

decisions.decision: Twenty-one variants: Validate=19 and Weights=20 extend both u8 codecs; new tests fix SCALE indices. Normal proxy_contract extraction cross-checks Python PROXY_TYPES and metadata. Runtime permission filters are not executed by the client.
FakeProxier adds has_delegator_proxies returning false. Chain mock support remains outside the client port; no claim to run these FRAME tests.

Due Null subnet now takes the first scheduler slot, preventing starvation under cap=1. The mapped blocks_until_next_auto_epoch body is unchanged; runtime slot ordering, deferred epochs and emission execution remain outside this extracted client projection.

Registration reasserts SubnetEmissionEnabled=true, including reused IDs; start_call activation remains separately gated. Native orchestration submits registration/start calls and correlates events; it does not simulate runtime emission initialization.

Fee payer traversal changes to at most three consecutively opted-in proxy levels; homogeneous direct proxy batches may terminate traversal, with four declared DB reads. Normal fee_contract extraction authenticates production declarations, imports, owners and exact method bodies. The client warning is not a payer resolver; charging/refunds and runtime policy execution remain outside the mapping.

Announcement sample sends cleartext V2 and compares a destination-and-policy commitment. Maintained source/staged checks cover the core test surface; actual coldkey lifecycle remains deferred under Q30. The core dependency stays v478 with the existing patch; these are parity-pin test inputs, not a core dependency upgrade.

Announcement sample wraps announce_coldkey_swap_v2(new_coldkey); legacy hash announcement remains raw-only. Sample source mapping does not assert live e2e execution or upgrade the separately pinned core dependency.

Metadata adds release reservation=154, V2 announcement=155 and root-only keep-locked reset=156; legacy hash call remains raw. Regeneration independently checks Python wire surfaces against authenticated V15/V16 metadata; metadata is not runtime execution.
Two reservation errors add indices 188/189; existing ColdKeyAlreadyAssociated index 58 remains with retired-error text. Normal regeneration independently checks metadata error identity/docs.

Adds destination reservation forward/reverse maps. Native descriptors are regenerated from pinned metadata and cross-checked with Python; absence, TTL and runtime reservation enforcement are not certified.

Included failed receipts now retain actual fee and triggered events. Candidate native submission already projects those into its typed result; pool rejection remains separate with no included receipt. Production-port review remains open.

Proof names the effective dispatch hotkey selected by proxy context and submits with the same context. Candidate native proof_hotkey also handles typed multisig/external context. This record identifies the consumer, not independent approval of signing/routing logic.

Remove --all resolves proxy context once; only direct local operation may follow with a hotkey-signed cleanup for Validate/Weights grants. External signer/no local hotkey skips that follow-up. Candidate native flow is mapped without claiming independent execution/semantic acceptance.

Set identity exposes all eight optional fields, reads current identity once and preserves omitted fields while permitting explicit empty strings. Candidate native identity flow owns this adaptation; independent port review stays open.

Swap-check distinguishes recovery-locked/no announcement from no state and carries recovery_locked in normal output. Native typed optional execute/hash fields and wallet views map this state; no runtime recovery execution is attested.

Retired associated-coldkey guidance now describes merges; adds both reservation descriptions. Normal leaf/assembly extraction and catalog generation validate exact text/provenance and Rust CHAIN_ERRORS descriptions.

Reservation occupied maps to AlreadyExists; reservation missing maps to NotFound. Normal literal extraction/catalog generation consumes the exact map; error classification makes no runtime admission claim.
Adds announceColdkeySwapV2(bytes32). Vendored SDK ABI and canonical Solidity counterpart are normal extraction inputs; ABI catalog comparison proves signature/selectors, not precompile execution.

Only subnet emission-enabled help changes: new registrations start true, root may disable; existing type/root-only control remains. Normal named-table/catalog generation consumes the help text; no local emission model is introduced.

Announce sends the cleartext account through V2, removes coldkey_hash and adds destination-signed reservation release. Typed native methods/generated calls cover these operations, summaries and warnings. Source prose still describes a simple stored hash while the core e2e fixture uses a policy commitment: the client constructs neither commitment and leaves it to runtime; do not invent client hash compatibility. Runtime lifecycle and independent inherited-port review remain open.

Adds Validate/Weights, HOTKEY_PROXY_TYPES and proxy_grant_signer; add/remove select hotkey dynamically, remove_proxies has from_hotkey=false default. Existing native doc aliases expose both helpers and typed SignerRole replaces Python strings. Candidate implementations/fixtures are mapped; independent port review remains open.

Only descriptions change: pool-side emission flag initially true and owner start_call still gates activation. Call shapes and policy declarations remain unchanged under normal extraction; orchestration is not a chain scheduler.
Only emission-enable description changes to default true for new registrations. Root origin, wraps and call arguments remain unchanged; normal extraction checks the actual declarations.

Dispute Some(0) yields recovery_locked even without announcement; execute/hash become optional. Other absent/nonzero dispute semantics remain explicit. Candidate typed read/generation represent the optional fields; independent behavior review remains open.
Only subnet_emission_enabled read help changes to new registrations starting enabled. Storage hit and parameter signatures remain unchanged under normal extraction.
RAW_ONLY adds legacy hash announce and root-only keep-locked reset; V2 announce/release become wrapped. Normal catalog/spec coverage checks enforce the split; runtime validation is separate.

Adds the zero-argument reservation-release sample. Normal authenticated sample resolver and catalog generation check coverage/shape. Sample availability does not mean running the runtime lifecycle or Python oracle.

Two new errors/classifications/descriptions plus revised retired error text. Vendored bytes are authenticated and normal extraction/catalog checks reproduce Rust output; no runtime error execution is claimed.

Adds reservation-release intent, V2 announce wraps, proxy hotkey cleanup field and updated help. Normal catalog/extraction/generation checks bind 86 intent interfaces; class-level defaults alone cannot attest dynamic signer behavior.

Updates coldkey swap optional/recovery-lock and emission help contracts without changing the 103-read inventory. Normal extractor/generator binds parameters, storage projections and interface bytes; runtime reads remain unverified.
